title: Gideon and the Verdict
author: Ada Vane
blurb: Odile Vasquez, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
